in_hebrew.name: Berriman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Berriman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Berriman is derived from the Old English words 'beor' meaning bright or famous and 'rige' meaning raven or dark one. This name was likely given to a child born during a time of conflict, signifying both the brightness of their spirit and the dark challenges they may face.
